entries.title: Restored cache lacks the generated schema
entries.root_cause: The schema cache key omits the schema revision, so the job restores an old cache that does not contain the generated manifest required by the build. Include the schema revision in the key and regenerate the cache.

entries.title: Artifact upload finds no files
entries.root_cause: The upload step points to the obsolete reports directory instead of the directory where the test runner writes results. Correct the artifact path.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Both failures report a missing path in an Actions job; this one occurs during artifact upload after tests and requires changing the upload path.

entries.title: Restored cache lacks the generated schema
